options.name: Proof-led narrow buying problem
options.objective: Generate qualified demand for the priority offer.

where_to_play.buying_situation: Teams actively evaluating ways to solve a recurring workflow problem.

options.how_to_win: Own one high-value buying problem through diagnosis, demonstrations and proof.
options.advantage_source: Documented ability to explain and demonstrate the problem-to-solution path.
options.economic_logic: Concentrate content around problems linked to the priority paid offer and measurable lead signals.
options.content_trust_mechanism: Use evidence-backed demonstrations, diagnosis and proof rather than generic advice.
options.distribution_logic: Use only channels already classified as supported or experimental for the target audience/state.

strategic_bets.statement: Focused proof-led content will produce higher-quality commercial conversations than broad generic content.
strategic_bets.uncertainty: Lead quality is not yet confirmed by enough first-party data.
strategic_bets.first_signal: Relevant qualified inquiries reference the demonstrated problem or proof.
strategic_bets.reversal_trigger: Repeated qualified conversations do not connect the content territory to the buying problem.

will_not_do: Broad category commentary with no link to the selected buying situation.

critical_assumptions.statement: The selected audience values concrete proof before purchase.

hard_gates.rationale: Evidence is sufficient for a bounded strategy.
The thesis supports the primary business objective.
The operating burden fits known capacity.
No known ethical or legal conflict.

reversal_conditions: New evidence shows a different buying situation consistently produces stronger qualified demand.
